newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express to revise pricing in summer.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express to revise pricing in summer.

text.p: Federal Express said on Wednesday it would revise its domestic pricing structure this summer, with new rates more closely aligned with the company's transportation costs.
Rates would be determined by the destination, weight and type of domestic service customers choose, the company said. The change would go into effect July 1, it said.

Previously, the company had charged flat rates, regardless of distance. A Federal Express said shipping distance would dictate whether the new pricing structure was cheaper or more expensive for customers.
"The new FedEx prices will be based on the weight and size of the shipment, the distance between the shipper and the recipient and the service commitment," the company said.
Federal Express said it had offered such region-based pricing on all international shipments and to certain domestic customers for many years.
Federal Express is an express transportation company.
